notes: Exalted: The Lunars supplied and inventoried cover-to-cover. 341 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/lunar/inventory/: the core innate powers, every Charm category in Chapter Five (pp. 122-193/PDF 125-196: Shapechanging I/II/III, Body Enhancement I/II, Unarmed Combat I-V, Melee Combat I/II, Ranged Combat I/II, Defensive I/II/III, Survival and Healing I/II/III/IV, Perception I/II/III/IV, Stealth, Interaction and Knowledge/Presence I/II/III/IV, Spirit, and Sorcery-access Charms), and all of Chapter Four: Traits (pp. 94-115/PDF 97-118): the altered Backgrounds (Artifact, Backing, Followers, Manse, Mentor), the new Backgrounds (Cult, Heart's Blood, Renown) plus a Regions sidebar, all three player Castes (Full Moon, Changing Moon, No Moon) and the Casteless state (this edition has three Castes, not the five-Caste structure from later editions), the universal Caste anima effects and Lunar Anima Banners table, the Great Curse (this splat's Limit-Trait analog) and its four Virtue-linked thralls, and the Face/Renown social-rank system. No dedicated Lunar-specific Merits/Flaws subsection or Tribe write-up exists in Exalted: The Lunars itself -- confirmed absent, not merely unreviewed. That gap is now filled by a second source: the Exalted Players Guide's Chapter One, "Merits and Flaws" (pp. 18-41/PDF 21-44), fully transcribed as 88 rows (44 merits + 44 flaws) applicable across all five planned Exalted families, with Lunar-specific eligibility/cost caveats (Lunars-only Chimera; Celestial-Exalted-only Known Anathema/Permanent Caste Mark/Greater Curse/Throwback; Abyssals-and-Ghosts-only Death-Taint, not applicable to Lunars) captured in each row's notes. Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. Only the untriaged cross-splat supplements (beyond the Players Guide) remain. Locked pending schema/rules/creator/editor implementation and passing tests across all five planned families.
